tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind lists, top bars and the summary card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, cards, the tab bar, sheets and notification cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, the search field, progress tracks, pressed rows, the off switch track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only — never the sole sign of a state.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines that carry meaning: the off switch, unselected radio, outline button. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — installed versions, sizes, timestamps, inactive tabs — on bg, surface, surface-raised and the soft tints (≥5:1).

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Brand fill: primary buttons, the active tab indicator, the app icon. Always paired with on-lime text.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on lime.

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: Brand as text or mark: the new version number, text actions, progress fill, selected radio. On bg, surface and lime-soft.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for downloading / ready chips and success activity icons, under lime-ink.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Signal fill for 'update available' only: tab count badges and dots. Never a button.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Numbers on amber badges.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: 'Update available' as text or icon: the update count, update chips, warn banners. On bg, surface and amber-soft.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for update chips and warn banners, under amber-ink.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed downloads, checksum mismatches, sign-out. Text/icon on bg, surface and danger-soft; always with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for failed chips, error banners and the danger button.

tokens.name: lime-inverse
tokens.usage: Text action on an inverted ground (snackbar action on ink). ≥6:1 on ink in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard / D-pad focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. ≥3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: tile-moss
tokens.usage: Monogram app-icon tile, with on-tile letter.

tokens.name: tile-rust
tokens.usage: Monogram app-icon tile, with on-tile letter.

tokens.name: tile-sea
tokens.usage: Monogram app-icon tile, with on-tile letter.

tokens.name: tile-plum
tokens.usage: Monogram app-icon tile, with on-tile letter.

tokens.name: tile-slate
tokens.usage: Monogram app-icon tile, with on-tile letter.

tokens.name: tile-sand
tokens.usage: Monogram app-icon tile — the one light tile: letter in on-tile-dark.

tokens.name: on-tile
tokens.usage: Monogram letter on every tile except tile-sand (≥5:1).

tokens.name: on-tile-dark
tokens.usage: Monogram letter on tile-sand.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Large title on tab roots; the update count.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: App name on the detail screen, onboarding headings.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Small top bar title on pushed screens; sheet titles.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: App names in rows, setting titles, button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers, text actions, small buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row meta, chips, tab labels, timestamps.

styles.name: version-lg
styles.usage: Version line on the detail screen and changelog headings.

styles.name: version
styles.usage: Versions in rows, APK file names, ABI tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in chips; gap inside meta lines.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, between stacked texts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row icon-to-text gap; vertical row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen gutter — every list, card and banner sits 16px from the edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card inner padding; space above a section header.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button side padding; gap between sections on onboarding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large button padding; hero spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Onboarding top spacing above the logo.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: ABI tags, tiny badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: 40px app icons, inputs inside sheets.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: 48px app icons, grouped lists, banners, file options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Summary card, notification cards, bottom sheets, 72px app icons.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, the search field, progress bars, the tab indicator.

size.note: Fixed component sizes, in dp for React Native.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable (use hitSlop on 36px buttons).

tokens.name: row-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an app row.

tokens.name: topbar-h
tokens.usage: Small top bar height.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, before the system gesture inset.

tokens.name: appicon-sm
tokens.usage: App icon in notifications and dense lists.

tokens.name: appicon-md
tokens.usage: App icon in rows.

tokens.name: appicon-lg
tokens.usage: App icon on the detail screen.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Only for things above the page: snackbars, bottom sheets, the phone frame in showcases.
